description:
[[Rock and roll]] entered [[Greece]] in the early 1960s. In this "[[Golden Youth 1960s era in Greece|Golden Youth]]" era, pop-rock bands were the first to appear, but were soon followed by the formation of true rock bands, such as [[Aphrodite's Child]].


 
Greek rock bands and performers in later decades include [[Socrates Drank the Conium]], [[Pavlos Sidiropoulos]], [[Dimitris Poulikakos]], and [[The Last Drive]]. In the beginning of the 1980s, there was a small but energetic number of [[Greek punk|punk]] and [[New wave music|New Wave]] bands, and in the 1990s [[hip-hop]] elements also entered the mainstream rock scene.
